summary: Tested server-side pagination on /api/leads. Backend returns {leads:[], pagination:{...}} correctly (7/7 pytest passed). Admin /admin/leads renders '2 total data' and lists 2 lead cards. Telecaller /agent/leads renders '2 data assigned to you' and lists 2 lead cards (used agent@test.com/agent123 since telecaller credential provided in request was invalid — teja@bankezee.com is an admin account).
